newsitem.title: USA: UPS names Ken Lacy new chief information officer.
newsitem.headline: UPS names Ken Lacy new chief information officer.

text.p: United Parcel Services said on Wednesday its chief information officer, Frank Erbrick, was retiring in January 1997 and would be replaced by Ken Lacy, the vice president of information services.

Lacy said on a conference call that he had spent nearly 30 years working for the privately-held U.S. package distribution company, and had managed the information services unit for the past two-and-a-half years.
Information technology had a budget of $1.65 billion in 1996, the company said.
